docscan.mdd: A crooked document. let me flatten it.
docscan.label.pick: Drag the four dots onto the page corners
docscan.status.idle: Pick a photo of the document
docscan.status.ready: Flattened to {w}×{h}. nudge the corners for a straighter result
docscan.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
docscan.err.pdfLib: Could not load the PDF library
docscan.note.manual: Corners are picked by hand on purpose. automatic detection fails on patterned desks and shadows, and when it fails you cannot see why. The scan look uses a local threshold, so a shadow across the page does not turn half of it black.
docscan.a11y.pick: Document corners. press 1-4 to pick a corner, arrows to move
